name: Paris-area social worker seeking stable daytime work

constraints: Qualification and client population must match
context.company_awareness: Knows local institutions but needs current vacancies

trigger: A fixed-term service contract approaches its end, prompting a search for continuity in a setting and population the worker can support confidently.

searches_run.query: travailleur social CDI journée Paris association hôpital
searches_run.observation: Results included associations, hospital PDFs, municipal recruitment and training pages. Broad social-work labels spanned several qualifications and populations; one nonprofit listing described a fixed-term evening/weekend pattern rather than the requested daytime CDI.

searches_run.query: assistant service social CDI Paris horaires journée diplôme public accompagné
searches_run.observation: The sample returned concrete qualification, population and hours language. Direct Valentin Haüy inspection showed a 28-hour CDI for work with visually impaired adults and a stated DEASS requirement, but contact-opening hours were not a job schedule.

sources.title: Assistant de service social — Association Valentin Haüy
sources.supports: Direct nonprofit posting states a Paris address, 28-hour CDI, DEASS requirement and adult visual-disability context. No individual daily schedule was specified; footer contact hours are not employee hours.

sources.title: Assistant de service social/Éducateur spécialisé — Samusocial de Paris
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet describes required diplomas, a women-focused service, a ten-month CDD with possible CDI and late/weekend shifts. A possible future CDI is not a current permanent contract.

sources.title: Assistant socio-éducatif d'accompagnement — Ville de Paris
sources.supports: Retrieved official employer snippet includes required qualifications, presence during opening hours and on-call/permanence obligations, illustrating schedule complexity.

best_entry_page.primary_query: emploi travailleur social CDI journée Paris
best_entry_page.promise: Compare local social-work postings by stated contract, service population, qualification requirements and schedule, with direct source links.
best_entry_page.cta: Check covered local employers and save a search using your actual professional title.
proof_needed: Verify nonprofit and hospital coverage before prioritising this landing.
Keep DEASS, DEES and other qualifications distinct; do not infer equivalence.
Show population and actual workplace, not only organisation headquarters.
Do not use contact hours as employee shifts or CDD-to-CDI possibilities as CDI.
Unknown schedules remain unknown in Pro description checks.

conversion_objections: Will you mix social-work qualifications as if interchangeable?
Who would I work with in this service?
Does daytime still include evenings or on-call periods?
Is this a real CDI or only a possible extension?
How far is the actual workplace?

avoid_targeting.reason: Qualification equivalence is not demonstrated and needs independent verification.
Training intent does not match an experienced job search.

avoid_targeting.query: emploi social journée garanti sans astreinte
avoid_targeting.reason: No schedule guarantee can be inferred from labels.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Mon contrat se termine et je cherche un poste durable, auprès d'un public que je connais. Montrez le diplôme demandé, le lieu exact et les horaires du poste; le nom d'une association et la mention CDI ne suffisent pas.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic French searcher. Two queries and one direct nonprofit inspection; no legal/credential or service-quality conclusions. Exact qualification, population preference and home location are unknown, limiting actual matching.
